content: # Managing Academic and Professional Stress and Burnout ## 1. Recognizing Burnout vs Everyday Fatigue Burnout is a state of emotional, physical, and mental exhaustion caused by excessive and prolonged stress. It occurs when you feel overwhelmed, emotionally drained, and unable to meet constant demands. Key signs include: - Chronic fatigue and low physical energy. - Cynicism, detachment, and emotional numbness toward tasks you previously enjoyed.

The 5-4-3-2-1 Sensory Grounding Technique The 5-4-3-2-1 grounding method is a clinically validated cognitive exercise designed to bring awareness back to the present moment during acute anxiety or distress. How to practice: - Notice 5 things you can see around you (e.g., a pen on the desk, light reflecting on a wall, a plant).
